what: O5R instrument tests. §三 requires a positive test, a negative test, a Target self-test, a Control self-test, a candidate-readable test and an explicit UNREADABLE state for every corrected instrument.
sealedBefore: any capture of the O5R candidate lane (opticalBody=target-source-unclamped)

selfTestSources.controlAndCandidate: artifacts/optics-o5/measure -- the O5 control and the O5 CLAMPED candidate. Neither is the O5R candidate.

results.test: edge-local chroma is reported at gradients, not as false colour
a broad cast is caught as false colour away from features
distance to Target is zero for an identical lane
distance to Target is large for the cast lane
refuses when there are no card rects
three identical lane values return UNREADABLE, not PASS
results.detail: grayscale: every lane returned the same value (0.0); the metric cannot discriminate here and a comparison against it would be vacuously true

results.test: differing lane values are not degenerate
reads a feature population on textured media
a broad cyan/magenta rim is caught by broadRimColouredFraction
colour following the texture keeps localisation up
refuses on media with no features
results.detail: saturated_edge_v2: this asset has no feature population (0 feature px, 43200 non-feature px); the feature-local question cannot be asked of it

results.test: the displacement encoding round-trips to inside one 8-bit code
saturated pixels are excluded, not decoded
disc centroids land on the discs, sub-pixel
a known shift is recovered exactly
an incomplete pairing refuses to report a mean
a pairing beyond the search radius is refused
refuses a card with no landmark contrast
results.detail: disc_blobs: card has no usable contrast (p2 120.0, p98 120.0); the calibration discs are not resolvable here

results.test: window measurement lands on the discs to well inside a pixel
a disc image split in two is still measured as one object
overlapping windows are refused, not shared
results.detail: [{'id': 0, 'measured': False, 'why': 'window overlaps disc(s) [1]'}, {'id': 99, 'measured': False, 'why': 'window overlaps disc(s) [0]'}]

results.test: displacement is measured against the unrefracted prediction, and recovers a known offset
a sharp texture reads higher HF than a blurred one
proximity, not sharpness: the blurrier lane wins when it is nearer
results.detail: |blurred-T| 63.24 < |sharp-T| 91.91; the O5 coding would have failed the nearer lane for being blurrier

results.test: a textured asset is applicable for sharpness
a flat asset is NOT_APPLICABLE, not a pass and not a failure
results.detail: Target interior HF energy 4.8 is below the pre-registered signal floor 20.0; this asset has no interior structure to measure and a difference here would be noise

results.test: a flat card falls below the signal floor
refuses a card too small to inset
a synthetically perfect card matches its silhouette
a square card is distinguishable from the rounded one
results.detail: square beyond 2276 iou 0.956231 vs perfect beyond 0

results.test: the measured corner radius recovers the real one
a square card measures a corner radius near zero
an antialias width is measurable from the soft map
refuses when no background can be sampled
results.detail: rendered_alpha_mask: the card rect touches every frame edge, so no background can be sampled

results.test: refuses mismatched mask shapes
refract() at normal incidence stays on the axis
total internal reflection returns the GLSL zero
the SDF is negative inside and positive outside
the bevel is zero at the outline, full inside
the dome falls away from the card centre
the media v flip is the documented one
a landmark outside the cover crop is reported outside, not clamped
reads real target pixels on grayscale-step
reads real control pixels on grayscale-step
reads real candidate pixels on grayscale-step
the lanes are not all the same value
the Target passes its own repeatability window
reads real target pixels on rgb-bars
reads real control pixels on rgb-bars
reads real candidate pixels on rgb-bars
reads real target pixels on hf-checker
reads real control pixels on hf-checker
reads real candidate pixels on hf-checker
hf-checker is applicable for sharpness on real Target pixels
reads a real target coverage mask
reads a real control coverage mask
reads a real candidate coverage mask
the sdf-mask program yields a real projected silhouette
the displacement program yields a real, non-constant field
the calibration discs are detectable in a real Target render
the §六 chain reads real target pixels
results.detail: 2/3 cards, displacement 18.399 px, replay residual 1.437 px

results.test: the replayed source formula lands on the Target's own render, which is what makes it usable as the Target's prediction
results.detail: mean residual 1.437 px over 2 cards, against the pre-registered 3.0 px

results.test: the §六 chain reads real control pixels
results.detail: 1/3 cards, displacement 14.724 px, replay residual 9.128 px

results.test: the replay's PROJECTION half agrees with the control's own card geometry
the §六 chain reads real o5-clamped pixels
results.detail: 2/3 cards, displacement 19.029 px, replay residual 2.096 px

results.test: the CPU replay agrees with the GPU displacement program
results.detail: p99 |dU| 0.00098 p99 |dV| 0.001044 vs one encoding step 0.001961 (4096 samples)
